questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}f(x)&=\lim_{n\rightarrow \infty}\frac{x^{2n+1}+ax^2+bx}{x^{2n}+1}=\begin{cases}x,|x|>1\\ \dfrac{1+a+b}{2},x=1\\ ax^2+bx,|x|<1\\ \dfrac{-1+a-b}{2},x=-1\end{cases}\\\lim_{x\rightarrow i+}f(x)&=1=f(1)=\dfrac{1+a+b}{2}=\lim_{x\rightarrow i-}f(x)=a+b\\\lim_{x\rightarrow i-}f(x)&=-1=f(-1)=\dfrac{-1+a-b}{2}=\lim_{x\rightarrow i+}f(x)=a-b\quad, \ \text{从而}a=0,b=1。\end{aligned}
